findings.motion: H.4359 On adoption of amendment #8, House Yea and Nay No. 132 (32 yeas, 126 nays)
findings.note: Decker is recorded N. A Beacon Hill Roll Call article (https://gazettenet.com/2022/02/03/beacon-hill-roll-call-jan-24-to-jan-28-2022-44905014/) says the House that day rejected, 32 to 126, an amendment requiring a federal or Massachusetts picture ID at the polls with a fee waiver. Two roll calls that day (No. 132 on amendment 8, and No. 139 on amendment 7, already on file) have that same 32-126 tally, and I could not confirm from the pages which amendment holds the ID text, so this match to the ID amendment is not confirmed.
